target.name: Axeyum.Autogenesis.intNegOnePowParityBridgeV1
target.statement_role: convert powFn k parity at k into powFn (n + 1) sign parity at n

explicit_contracts: rawPower : forall k, powFn k = if k % 2 = 0 then 1 else -1
modCases : forall n, n % 2 = 0 or n % 2 = 1
method: split on modCases n, use the corresponding successor parity contract, normalize rawPower at n + 1, and normalize the target conditional at n
limitations: The bridge remains parameterized until exact checked specialization.
